Robinhood Markets has agreed to pay $45 million to settle its cases filed by the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). In a document shared by the agency, Robinhood Markets violated rules on blue sheet filing, identity theft, and suspicious activity reporting, including a 2021 data breach that exposed customers’ data.
 
 
Two brokers of Robinhood Markets – Robinhood Securities and Robinhood Financial – are the primary units responsible for accepting and executing trades. As such, the SEC ordered that both units would share in covering the penalties.

Con una prevendita che ha già raccolto oltre 10 milioni di dollari, il progetto Layer-2 Solaxy sta guadagnando attenzione come una delle innovazioni più promettenti nello spazio blockchain. Creato per affrontare le principali sfide della rete di Solana, come scalabilità, congestione e tempi di inattività, Solaxy rappresenta una svolta significativa, che sta stuzzicando numerosi trader.
 
Attualmente disponibile al prezzo di 0,001596 dollari per token, $SOLX offre un’opportunità interessante per gli investitori iniziali, promettendo un valore crescente con il progredire del progetto.

articles.title: Il nuovo progetto Layer-2 Solaxy supera i 10 milioni di dollari in prevendita

articles.author: Jake Simmons
articles.description:
In a newly released memo dated January 13, 2025, Matt Hougan, Chief Investment Officer (CIO) at Bitwise, argues that the phenomenon of corporations purchasing Bitcoin for their treasuries is far more widespread and influential than most investors realize. According to Hougan, “We’ll see hundreds of companies buy Bitcoin for their treasuries over the next 12-18 months, and their purchases will lift the entire Bitcoin market substantially higher.”
 
Hougan’s memo, titled “Companies Buying Bitcoin: An Overlooked Megatrend,” asserts that while MicroStrategy and its outspoken founder, Michael Saylor, often dominate headlines, they are merely the most visible part of a rapidly expanding corporate movement into BTC.
 
Despite being ranked 220th globally by market capitalization—“a bit bigger than…
articles.title: Hundreds Of Companies Will Buy Bitcoin Over The Next 12-18 Months: Fund CIO

articles.author: Ian Allison
articles.description:
The runaway success of Base, the Coinbase-owned Ethereum overlay blockchain designed for faster, cheaper transactions, has prompted the creation of a market linked to the fluctuating cost of the total gas needed to power the network, allowing speculators to bet on recurring utility spikes on the layer 2 system.
Taking a cue from the way traders speculate and hedge in traditional energy markets, Alkimiya, a startup backed by Coinbase Ventures as well as firms like Dragonfly and Castle Island Ventures, enables users to go long or short on the cost of transactions being included in blocks, or “blockspace” – a representation of the storage and computational capacity of a blockchain.
“Paying for blockspace is like paying for other energy sources, such as cars paying for petrol or aeroplanes pay…
articles.title: Coinbase’s Layer 2 System Base Gets a Marketplace Linked to Gas Revenue
